parsed.lessons_learned: Absorption is real when you buy small amounts over multiple cycles — LiquidKiller and BearKing were right about my $11,200 having zero price impact. To break absorption, I need to concentrate buying power into fewer cycles. $15k in one cycle creates more price impact than $11,200 across 5 cycles. Lesson: don't telegraph accumulation by spreading buys across cycles — concentrate force when you want market movement. Also: the squeeze play NEEDS a trigger catalyst, not just passive accumulation. My 4th ETH buy without trading volume was just another data point. My 5 ETH buy with a public statement creates narrative AND price impact.
